$comment: BUILD TEMPLATE — Duo Geo Rush (Cortex, ATG). Two commanders (skirmish: /cheat 2nd com + 1000 metal to mimic 2nd player start). Reference run: run-003 (2026-06-10). Energy-gated build: the geo's 13,000 E cost is the wall; the solar bank is its fuel tank.

sequence.action: chain solars continuously — this is the geo's energy bank, not eco greed
con turret (cornanotc) placed WITHIN 400 elmos of the geo spot — it must reach the geo
energy converters (cormakr) sized to geo surplus: ~(post-geo eInc - baseline) / 70, ≈ 7

checkpoints.$comment: Reference times from run-003. Grade future attempts against these; 'gate' = what limits that phase.

economics.comparison: geo TROI 169s vs wind 213s @ wind 14 vs solar 542.5s — best energy investment in the game; the 13,000 E upfront wall is the catch
economics.geoBuildDrain: ~282 e/s at full 295bp (worker 95 + turret 200) — exceeds typical T1 income, hence the solar bank
economics.converterSizing: post-geo surplus ≈ 500 e/s -> 7 converters (70 e/s each) ≈ +7 m/s

knownIssues.run003GeoEfficiency: geo built at ~57% BP efficiency (77s actual vs 44s theoretical) — energy bottomed at 10 during the dive because 2 corlevlr + expansion mexes (500e each) competed in the geo window
fixes: one more solar in the bank phase before geo start, OR
hold the levlrs and far expansion mexes until geo is online
